content.comment_body: Good morning everyone, I have a question regarding setting up an IP camera for [product_name]. I've followed the [company_name] guide for this process, but results have been limited. Currently, the camera is on the work network and the controller is connected to my PC. My main issue is that the video stream takes some time to load, and once it loads, it's delayed. The stream then attempts to catch up, sometimes fast forwarding. I'm using a Reolink RLC-810A IP camera. Another challenge is that with the same settings, I can't display an image through my remote setup, which includes a Teltonika Rut-240, [product_name], and RLC-810A. I suspect my configuration may be the cause—perhaps a VPN is needed? Does anyone know an alternative method to achieve this? Thanks in advance, I appreciate any suggestions!
Hello [user_name], I suggest reviewing the following manual, especially page 43 and the example on page 83, as they could be helpful: [document] Online Help

Hello, Thank you for your response. I've thoroughly studied and followed the document, but it doesn't provide detailed information about the specific settings required. I managed to get an image, but it appears choppy and I haven't found the proper setting in VLC to convert the stream into still images with 1–3 second intervals. I tried adjusting the MJPEG/MPEG source settings with different intervals, but the stream still demands too much quality for my setup. I'm willing to upload an example if anyone has insights into this specific topic.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing difficulties setting up a smooth IP camera stream in the [product_name] environment. The video feed experiences delay and attempts to catch up, resulting in choppy or accelerated playback. Guidance from the available documentation and VLC settings hasn't resolved the lag issue. Accessing the feed remotely, especially when using additional network hardware, further complicates matters, likely due to bandwidth or compatibility limitations. More detailed and scenario-specific configuration advice is needed for reliable video streaming.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks stable, low-latency, and high-quality IP camera video streaming with [product_name], both locally and remotely. They expect comprehensive setup instructions tailored to various network configurations.
